fitted_stdk_baseline.note: Same fitted q05/q50/q95 STDK models used to generate QConvLSTM grids; not the historical obs100-scaled standalone run.

evaluation_protocol.training_scope: independent QConvLSTM fit for every target location in this scenario
evaluation_protocol.train: one quantile-specific fitted STDK Train700 series per target location (500 independent fits)
evaluation_protocol.validation: the same target location's fitted STDK Val150 series, checkpoint selection only
evaluation_protocol.space_boundary: times 0..4 use direct Spatial-adapter STDK warm-up; QConvLSTM starts at time 5 with legal STDK histories 0..4
